CPU_failed_audit_attempts.kind: audit expectation omitted standard resolved task metadata
audit used per-segment observation declaration instead of full Gaussian schedule

accounting.CPU_timing_scope: In-script bodies; excludes startup/import and report preparation
accounting.charging_scope: Popen to supervisor exit, including evaluation and overhead; not exclusive CUDA device time

limitations: One deterministic source-bound training comparison, not a calibrated statistical population claim.
Full unequal-mass transfer is decisive; increased passing checks do not waive its failed gate.
Gaussian has one learned cell and cannot alone establish multi-cell quota adaptation; unequal-mass traces and floor/ceiling guards provide that control.
Passive training traces lack component-gradient snapshots; the single-delta comparison supports a local mechanism claim, not universal causal attribution.

preregistration.checkpoint_reuse: Only each new arm own passing 1000-update smoke; no old producer or cross-task state.
preregistration.falsifier: No full mode_hold repair, Gaussian adaptation/control regression, unequal-mass full failure, any finite/RNG/checkpoint/capacity guard failure, or incomplete original horizon. A partial metric improvement never counts as PASS.

mechanism.adaptation: Old q can stay only while it lies in current floor/ceiling bounds. Crossing a bound forces a move. No smoothing/horizon changes, quota freezing, assignment relaxation or global hyperparameters.
mechanism.assignment: Original exact-capacity hard Hungarian matching; no soft, unbalanced or held-assignment training.
mechanism.rule: For each current expected allocation e_i, q_i is floor(e_i) or ceil(e_i), positive, sum(q)=kernel capacity. Minimize L1 distance to previous allocation among feasible q. Break ties by original largest-remainder fractional order and cell index. Start with original largest-remainder allocation. Reject every originally invalid empty-quota reference before alternative selection.

preregistration.parent_revision_note: Parent numeric law unchanged; both arms run under one new source binding for a matched comparison. Old evidence remains under its original source.
preregistration.passive_receipts: Capture already-computed allocations/assignment changes and real-data digests. Retain already-scored mode-hold samples; no extra evaluation draws. Measure actual updates, logs, PIDs, leases, costs and full original metrics.
preregistration.prediction: SUPPORT only if minimum_change passes the original full mode_hold gate while matched parent fails, and minimum_change also passes unchanged full Gaussian stability and full unequal-mass transfer. Any full-gate failure keeps overall FAIL; paired quota-switch receipts are secondary mechanism observations.
preregistration.protocol: Original seed0 deterministic initializer, same data/batches, architecture, initial MoG capacity/width, sampling, schedules, horizons and every gold gate. One global recipe per arm across all tasks.

roles.vector_unequal_mass: Prospectively reserved transfer evaluation; no new-arm metric used for implementation/tuning; historical task/control outcomes are known

preregistration.secondary_quota_evidence: Explicitly posthoc endpoint diagnosis; not proof of training failure causation.
preregistration.stopping_rule: Complete independent cells in current tier regardless of scientific failures. Smoke failure blocks only its own stability dependency. No retries, alternate recipes, parameter grids or post-result edits. Stop at original reservations/physical caps.

algorithm.aggregate_swap: Enumerate unordered kernel pairs (i<j) in different cells after the ordinary Hungarian solve. For each pair recompute affected cell mean and centered covariance from first/second moments with original jitter. Score exact unchanged mass-weighted aggregate forward-KL. Choose lowest-scoring pair in lexicographic kernel-index order; apply only if a final centered-covariance recomputation gives strict total loss reduction. At most one swap per update, no swap-history state and no change to capacities.
algorithm.equal_shape: L=sum(q_c/K*placement_c)+sum(shape_c)/C. Same global reg_coeff, no new tunable multiplier.
algorithm.prior_signal: Existing optimizer_signal_roles=[generator,prior]; checkpointed history and normalization unchanged.

preregistration.confirmation_rule: Only recipes passing every original regression gate may receive untouched reserved unequal_width and ring16_acquisition evaluations under the same frozen recipe, with full task reservations and remaining budgets checked first. Historical task results are known. No tuning after stage outcomes.
preregistration.falsifier: Original full gate FAIL/INCOMPLETE/INVALID, guard failure or original horizon not completed. A failing first-stage recipe gets no further training in this fixed portfolio round.
preregistration.fractional_transport: Proposal4 remains feasibility-only; no GPU admission under this preregistration. It requires a separate frozen numeric law and decision before execution.
preregistration.prediction: A repair requires original full unequal-mass evaluator PASS, not merely final covariance<=0.85 or improved passing-check count. Confirm local repair only against same-source control failure; no generalization claim at this stage.
preregistration.regression_rule: For any first-stage passing new recipe, freeze it and run the original mode_hold and own Gaussian smoke/stability continuation when remaining budget can reserve the full regression block. Preserve all full gates. Shared control regression only when needed for paired attribution; archival control stays separately source-bound.
preregistration.stopping_rule: Finish all four independent initial tasks even after scientific failures. No seed repeats, paid retries, hyperparameter grid or combination selected post-result. Preserve failed preflights and costs. If budget cannot admit a complete subsequent block report BLOCKED_BUDGET, never shorten tasks.

preregistration.CPU_feasibility: Synthetic only; 24 small integer LP-vs-Hungarian objective and feasibility fixtures; fractional row/column residual<=1e-7; weighted loss/gradient one-hot equivalence; positive finite gradients; public trainer exact checkpoint continuation and control bitwise parent match. Max180 CPU wall seconds total preflight; 32 synthetic K256 C4 solves, projected1200 solve cost must be<300 seconds to leave at least295 seconds for original training and supervision. No numerical retuning after outcomes.

algorithm.fractional: Keep consumed-data exponential8 counts, means, covariance and per-kernel Gaussian forward-KL cost unchanged. Solve min sum(P*C) with P>=0, every row sum1, column sums K*count/sum(count); use deterministic SciPy HiGHS dual simplex in float64, primal/dual feasibility tolerance1e-9, last capacity computed as K minus preceding capacities to remove floating summation residual. No entropy, warm start, penalty, stochasticity or gradient through P. Weighted cell means sum(P*m)/capacity; weighted centered covariance sum(P*(cov+(m-center)(m-center)^T))/capacity plus original jitter; mass-weighted aggregate forward-KL with capacity/K. Public sampling stays the uniform positive-width MoG. Existing integer reference allocations persist only as inert comparative diagnostics; they do not enter this arm training loss. Integer control branch untouched.

preregistration.confirmation_rule: Only recipes passing every original regression gate may receive untouched reserved unequal_width and ring16_acquisition evaluations under the same frozen recipe, with full task reservations and remaining budgets checked first. Historical task results are known. No tuning after stage outcomes.
preregistration.falsifier: Any failed original full gate/guard/horizon rejects this frozen recipe; any feasibility failure prevents GPU admission. No paid retry.
preregistration.fractional_transport: Admitted only after all preregistered CPU feasibility checks pass and original full reservations fit both remaining accounting views.
preregistration.prediction: Fractional capacity must pass original full unequal-mass gate while same-source integer control fails. Lower endpoint error or smoother assignments alone is insufficient. No global claim.
preregistration.regression_rule: For any first-stage passing new recipe, freeze it and run the original mode_hold and own Gaussian smoke/stability continuation when remaining budget can reserve the full regression block. Preserve all full gates. Shared control regression only when needed for paired attribution; archival control stays separately source-bound.
preregistration.stopping_rule: Complete both independent first-stage jobs. A failing new recipe stops. If it passes, complete original mode_hold plus own Gaussian smoke/stability at full reservations, then untouched width/ring confirmation only if all regression gates pass and full reserve fits. No tuning, seed repeat, combination, or budget expansion.

preregistration.CPU_feasibility: Synthetic only. Verify identity/permutation zero losses, finite gradients, translation invariance of shape penalties, normal-panel antipodal pairing and no RNG draws, active distinct public trainer models, exact checkpoint continuation, original control parity. Total successful preflight180 CPU seconds; 14 public trainer calls per arm. No numerical tuning after real outcomes.

algorithm.common: Retain the exact baseline loss/reference/assignment. Add coefficient1 times mass-weighted conditional shape discrepancy. Generate an extra deterministic 64-point normal integration panel per kernel: first32 points after skipping the zero of unscrambled Sobol, inverse normal transform, paired antithetically. No RNG and no change to public sampling. Group generated outputs by original hard assignment. Real outputs are the last8 consumed batches, assigned to nearest current reference mean. Select up to256 evenly spaced row indices per cell from generated and real panels, center each panel at its own empirical mean, whiten both by current data-reference inverse square root. One-dimensional direction +1; two-dimensional 8 directions at angles pi*j/8. Other output dimensions are unsupported for these recipes. Fail on empty cell. Same scale and original Gaussian base for all3 additions.
algorithm.fourth: Average across directions of squared projected fourth-moment difference divided by (1+real fourth moment)^2. Fourth moments are centered/whitened as common panel.
algorithm.rbf: Biased empirical Gaussian RBF MMD squared, including diagonals. Bandwidth squared is the median positive pairwise squared distance of the centered whitened real panel; machine epsilon floor only.
algorithm.sliced: Mean squared difference of linearly interpolated empirical sorted projection quantiles at128 midpoint probabilities, averaged over fixed directions.

preregistration.regression_rule: For any first-stage passing new recipe, freeze it and run the original mode_hold and own Gaussian smoke/stability continuation when remaining budget can reserve the full regression block. preregistration.stopping_rule: Complete all4 independent first-stage jobs. Only passing new recipes advance to original regression then untouched confirmation within full reservations and cumulative ceilings. Continue evaluating other distinct authorized portfolio ideas after terminal outcomes; never revive failed exact recipes.

preregistration.CPU_feasibility: Synthetic only. Exact checkpoint replay, stream parity, control bitwise parity; distinct active outputs. Exhaustive small minimum-switch optimum, covariance convex update and positive definiteness, worst objective fixture, conflicting-gradient projection fixture, linear-map extragradient identity. All6 complete feasibility checks before source freeze. Failed implementation checks retained; no scientific tuning.

algorithm.extragradient_map: Two-evaluation extragradient of the existing composite public update map (D then G/prior), not simultaneous gradient extragradient. Let T_h(x) denote public step with original optimizer/history h and real batch. Predictor y=T_h(x). Restore complete original non-model state/streams, install predictor model tensors, compute z=T_h(y) with same data/RNG. Final floating model tensors x+(z-y); nonfloating tensors from corrector. Keep corrector optimizer/history/reference/stream state; completed step count advances once. This includes G,D,prior and EMA model tensors. Capture callable generator_real once and reuse it. Original public API, task horizon1200 accepted updates,2400 public-map evaluations charged in runtime; no altered nominal learning rates.
algorithm.minimum_switch: First assignment original Hungarian. Thereafter solve Hungarian with normalized original per-kernel cost in [0,1] plus (K+1) for changing previous cell. This exactly prioritizes minimum membership changes under current exact quotas, then minimizes original cost. Store previous assignment in checkpoint. Original aggregate loss unchanged.
algorithm.projected_cells: For each mass-weighted per-cell forward-KL placement+shape term compute joint G/prior gradient. For each cell in increasing ID, sequentially remove negative projections on original other cell gradients in increasing ID: gi <- gi -min(gi dot gj,0)*gj/||gj||^2, skipping zero norm. Sum projected cell gradients and unmodified adversarial/prior gradient. Existing G-only signal attenuation applied afterward. No new coefficient or random ordering.
algorithm.slow_covariance: After original exponential8 reference update, replace only covariance by31/32 previous served covariance +1/32 current raw reference covariance; initialize at step8 raw covariance. Recompute inverse and logdet. Counts, means, quotas and consumed-data memory unchanged. Previous served covariance is checkpointed in reference.
algorithm.worst_shape: Loss is unchanged mass-weighted placement plus maximum cell normalized forward-KL shape. Torch scalar max distributes exact tie subgradient equally; no new coefficient.
